title: Roger Craig's 1,000-yard rushing, 1,000-yard receiving season set a new standard

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Roger Craig's 1,000-yard rushing, 1,000-yard receiving season set a new standard
sources.description: When 49ers running back Roger Craig had 1,050 rushing yards and 1,016 receiving yards in 1985, he was doing something previously unthinkable in the NFL.
